result:
If I could change just one thing, it would be to make empathy the default setting for human decision-making.

Not empathy as a nice ideal, but as a practical, automatic check: before you act, you can instantly and clearly feel the weight of how that action lands on other people, especially those you don't see or don't agree with.

With that in place, a lot of other problems start solving themselves. Wars become harder to start, exploitation becomes harder to hide, cruelty becomes harder to normalize. People would still disagree, still compete, still make mistakes — but the baseline would shift from "what can I get away with" to "what would I want done to me."

What about you?
